package app

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The host test supplies the actual Golder-adapted output of a complete,
// multi-packet kitty-browse frame. No terminal, browser, or user data is used.
func TestGolderBrowserWorkspaceGraphicsIsolation(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(os.Getenv("GOLDER_TEST_GRAPHICS_FRAME"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	frame := string(raw)
	end := strings.Index(frame, "\x1b\\")
	if end < 0 {
		t.Fatal("frame has no first packet")
	}
	end += 2
	h := newSyncHoldHarness(t)
	browser := h.pane("browser", 0)
	other := h.pane("other", 40)
	browser.write(frame)
	other.write(frame)
	if got := hostActions(h.tick()); strings.Count(got, "p") != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("initial images were not placed: %q", got)
	}
	h.info["browser"].WindowX = 4
	if got := hostActions(h.tick()); !strings.Contains(got, "p") {
		t.Fatalf("browser image did not follow its pane: %q", got)
	}
	h.info["browser"].WindowX = 0
	h.tick()
	otherID := h.kp.imageIDMap["other"][1]
	// Begin the next frame, then switch workspaces while the rest of the image
	// is still in flight. The old browser image must be removed immediately.
	browser.write(frame[:end])
	h.info["browser"].Visible = false
	hidden := h.tick()
	if got := hostActions(hidden); !strings.Contains(got, "d") {
		t.Fatalf("switch during partial frame did not hide the old image: %q", got)
	}
	if strings.Contains(hidden, fmt.Sprintf("a=d,d=i,i=%d,", otherID)) {
		t.Fatal("hiding the browser deleted another pane's image")
	}
	browser.write(frame[end:])
	assertHidden := func(out string) {
		t.Helper()
		actions := hostActions(out)
		// Tuios writes the whole pending batch inside one synchronized host
		// update, so a placement followed by its delete is never displayed.
		if strings.Contains(actions, "p") && strings.LastIndex(actions, "d") < strings.LastIndex(actions, "p") {
			t.Fatalf("hidden browser left a visible placement: %q", actions)
		}
		if strings.Contains(out, fmt.Sprintf("a=d,d=i,i=%d,", otherID)) {
			t.Fatal("browser frame deleted the other pane's image")
		}
	}
	assertHidden(h.tick())
	for range 5 {
		browser.write(frame)
		assertHidden(h.tick())
	}
	h.info["browser"].Visible = true
	if got := hostActions(h.tick()); !strings.Contains(got, "p") {
		t.Fatalf("browser image did not return after switching back: %q", got)
	}
	// Switching to another session removes the old window from the model
	// rather than merely marking it invisible. It must hide just as promptly.
	browser.write(frame[:end])
	delete(h.info, "browser")
	removed := h.tick()
	if got := hostActions(removed); !strings.Contains(got, "d") {
		t.Fatalf("session switch did not remove the old image: %q", got)
	}
	if strings.Contains(removed, fmt.Sprintf("a=d,d=i,i=%d,", otherID)) {
		t.Fatal("session switch removed another pane's image")
	}
}
